completion_rule: Every requirement needs actual run output, source review or rendered artifact. A schema, green test fixture or nonempty table alone does not prove historical coverage.

gates.requirement: Every existing company audited and new-company onboarding generic
gates.proof: DB count/IDs equal coverage report; unseen private-company fixture traverses pipeline without code edits.
Same-URL changed bytes produce separate revisions; failed retry preserves last success; restore rehearsal passes.
DAY/month/year/unknown/relative/announcement/approval/filing/archive-capture fixture suite; all source passages inspected.
Apple founding-only negative; Windows parent maturity vs product phase; predecessor merger does not reset operating stage.
Same founder changes build/pricing/retention objective; outputs differ appropriately or explain true coverage gap.

gates.requirement: Complete useful episodes rather than date cards
gates.proof: Reviewed actions, pricing/team/marketing/IP/legal tracks where relevant, outcomes or explicit gaps; not merely six repeated snippets.
Every factual sentence cites reviewed claim IDs, source revisions and locators; no fabricated numerical/date/name claims.

gates.requirement: Conflict and review decisions survive ingestion
gates.proof: Ford competing dates preserved after all import/extraction paths, withheld until explicit reviewed resolution; reviewer journal intact.
Negative cases for IPO->demand, launch->retention and mismatched business model; one case labeled case study; patterned claims supported independently.
Price/version/currency/period terms, headcount scope/date, patent date kinds/assignee ownership and legal event distinctions tested.

gates.requirement: APIs honest about access and coverage
gates.proof: Each enabled provider has contract fixture, quota test, licensed use record and bounded live smoke; missing key explicitly blocked, never silently mocked live.
Additive migration replay, stable IDs, dual-read comparison and app rollback with no destructive reverse migration.

gates.requirement: Private data and untrusted documents safe
gates.proof: Tenant isolation on retrieval/cache/citation, upload/SSRF/parser/prompt-injection adversarial tests.
Measured bounded batch memory, latency, disk/cost budget, outage/backoff/checkpoint tests; public health during refresh.
Authenticated mobile and desktop screenshots with evidence drawer and zero/partial/ready cases; public URL200 alone insufficient.
All companies and requested tracks enumerated. No silent pilot-only completion; unresolved core gaps remain backlog and goal active.

test_policy: Add regression before behavior change. Keep existing focused lifecycle/import/date-conflict/API tests. Add a real DOM/browser E2E runner for rendered interactions; existing source-string tests cannot prove layout. Use only permitted browser tools when agent verifies UI.

commands.ingestion: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.vps.yml exec -T ingestion .venv/bin/python manage.py test apps.history apps.ingestion.test_historical_date_conflicts
commands.backend: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.vps.yml exec -T main-backend python manage.py test apps.accounts
commands.frontend: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.vps.yml build main-frontend
commands.migration_check: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.vps.yml exec -T ingestion .venv/bin/python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run
commands.note: Commands for proposed modules become runnable after implementation. Build/test new code before copying to or restarting live runtime; a green test against old container code is not proof. Prefer isolated Compose project/test DB with bounded resources and approved preservation.
